answers.core: Enhances core functionality, isn't very complex (seemingly, of course I can be mistaken), workarounds aren't perfect.
answers.workaround:
Used often.
Some workarounds exists, but they compromise some of the quality:
* Custom emitting as demonstrated above. This has a few limitations: particles emitted from script lag behind one frame (I'm not sure if this is a bug or if it's workable), user needs to reimplement emitter shapes, initial velocities etc.
* Using bigger emitter shape or add random velocity to spread out the particles. Might or might not align with artistic intent.
* Raise `fixed_fps`. Helps only partially.

title: Interpolate particle emit positions when emitter is moving fast
